svg.title: Current growth and decay in an RL circuit
svg.desc: (a) A resistor R and inductor L in series with a battery through a two-position switch. In position 1 the battery drives a current that grows; in position 2 the battery is cut out and the current decays as energy is lost in the resistor. (b) In position 1 the current rises from zero toward I0, reaching 0.632 I0 after one time constant τ = L/R and nearly I0 by 4τ. (c) In position 2 the current falls from I0 to 0.368 I0 after one time constant and nearly to zero by 4τ.
